mechanism: Adalimumab (TNF-α inhibitor) increases infection risk and potentially impairs immune response, while isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and both drugs have immunomodulatory effects that may compound adverse effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use effective contraception (isotretinoin is absolutely contraindicated in pregnancy), monitor closely for infections, and consider alternative therapies for acne in patients on TNF-α inhibitors.
